newsitem.title: USA: Fischer names Patrick Thomas CFO.
newsitem.headline: Fischer names Patrick Thomas CFO.

text.p: Fischer Imaging Corp said Tuesday that Patrick Thomas will join the company as vice president of finance and chief financial officer.
Thomas will replace James Newcomb, who has resigned to pursue other interests, Fischer said.
Thomas was most recently vice president and chief financial officer for Sweetwater Inc in Longmont, Colo.
Fischer Imaging Corp designs, manufactures, and markets specialty and general purpose x-ray imaging systems for the diagnosis and treatment of disease.
